verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a comprehensive Admin REST API and Admin CLI (kcadm) covering realms, users, roles, clients, and authorization policies — the same operations available in the Admin Console (keycloak-docs-6, keycloak-docs-37, kc-supp-kcadm) — and even explicitly notes admin-protected resources are manageable via 'Admin Console or the Admin REST API' (kc-supp-scim), suggesting close parity. However, hands-on community evidence reports the API is 'inconsistent' and hard to use idempotently for automation (keycloak-comm-13), and no discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec was found (keycloak-probe-3), undercutting a clean full-parity claim for AI-native/API-first consumption. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec for the Admin API, and independent confirmation that all UI-only workflows (e.g. some theme/console-only settings) have full 1:1 API equivalents without friction.
